Definition: Residue-level binding information from NMR (chemical-shift perturbation, HSQC titration, paramagnetic relaxation enhancement) or from site-directed mutagenesis abolishing binding
Direct binding to the disordered region established biophysically (ITC, SPR, microscale thermophoresis, fluorescence, backscattering interferometry) with no residue-level map
Cellular or functional activity attributed to the protein, with no direct evidence of binding to the disordered region
Usable as: excluded from all labels; retained as a documented watch list
